caption: The video captures a wide sunset beach scene. The sky shows a smooth vertical gradient from teal through pink to an orange-red band at the horizon. A dark calm sea occupies the lower view with thin pale streaks of reflected light shifting slowly across its surface. On the right wet sand mirrors the orange-red sky and a low dark landmass sits on the horizon right of center. The gradient horizon landmass and framing remain essentially unchanged throughout the excerpt. The subtle shifts in the water's reflective streaks and wet sand indicate gentle surface motion continuing across the visible clip. No object enters or leaves the scene and the view stays focused on coastal light.
